1.w: Not to us, O YHWH, not to us, but to Your name, give glory, because of Your loving devotion, because of Your faithfulness!

2.w: Why should the nations say, “Where now [is] their God?”

3.w: And our God [is] in the heavens; all that he has pleased, He has done.

4.w: Their idols [are] silver and gold, the work of the hands of man.

5.w: A mouth [is] unto them, and they do not speak; eyes [are] unto them, and they do not see;

6.w: ears [are] unto them, and they do not hear; noses [are] unto them, and they do not smell;

7.w: they have hands and they do not feel; they have feet and they do not walk; and they do not utter by their throat.

8.w: Those making them shall be like them, everyone who is trusting in them.

9.w: O Israel, trust in YHWH! And He [is] their help and their shield.

10.w: O House of Aaron, trust in YHWH! And He [is] their help and their shield.

11.w: O fearers of YHWH, trust in YHWH! He [is] their help and their shield.

12.w: YHWH has remembered us; He will bless; He will bless the house of Israel, He will bless the house of Aaron.

13.w: He will bless those fearing YHWH, the small with the great.

14.w: YHWH adds to you⁺—to you⁺ and to your⁺ sons!

15.w: May you⁺ [be] blessed by YHWH, maker of the heavens and the earth!

16.w: The heavens of the heavens [are] unto YHWH, and the earth He has given to the sons of man.

17.w: The dead do not praise YAH, and not any of those going down into silence.

18.w: And we will bless YAH, from now and even to forever. Hallelu YAH!
